svg.title: ZoneWatch - PTZ Controls window
svg.desc: The ZoneWatch PTZ Controls window, opened from the main window's PTZ Controls button. It holds the ONVIF camera address, username and a masked password, a zoom target of 0.5 and a 5 second hold, the Test Motion Detection, Parse RTSP URL, Continous Move, Relative Move, PTZ Agent api and Absolute Move buttons, and a log showing a motion test followed by an absolute zoom that returns after 5 seconds. The motion test's camera feed of the storage yard fills the lower part of the window.
